title: pilea gracilis subsp. subtriplinervia
intro: Pilea gracilis subsp. subtriplinervia, commonly known as Pilea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Pilea include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
